name: ExactlyProtocol
fix_description: In noTransferLeverage, add reentrancy guard or follow checks-effects-interactions. External calls during leverage operation allow re-entry before position state is updated.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires deep protocol-specific understanding of Exactly’s DebtManager, Auditor liquidity accounting, ERC4626 share-to-asset conversion, and how backupEarnings can be manipulated across maturities to force liquidations. The PoC is a long multi-stage attack using cloned fake markets, victim-specific state abuse, Uniswap V3 pool setup, collateral distortion, and liquidation chaining, which is well beyond a straightforward bug pattern.
